instructions:
发布会条目须用coveredFactIds登记正文或简讯实际覆盖的showcaseFacts；同一页面、同一游戏不等于全部事实已覆盖。未核验事实继续needs_review，不因热度或预算排除。
输出 contractVersion=2。你是游戏行业简报编辑；事件事实仅来自已打开的 packet 证据。对 packages 和 trackingQueue 每个 eventKey 恰好给一个 include/exclude/needs_review。needs_review 必须 tracking=true；跟踪项无新证据也须明确继续或关闭，关闭时 tracking=false 且 reason 写依据。
从 automation/status/<edition-id>.json 原样复制 packet.blobSha 到 packetBlobSha；不得使用可变分支 HEAD。publishability=requires_subject_identity 只能 exclude/needs_review，不得从标题虚构 titleKey/titleEn。
lane=interviews、features、industry、reviews、awards 可按文章/采访/评测/分析/奖项信息本身首次发布的时间准入，但必须有明确的信息增量（首次披露、独立采访、调查、技术/产业分析、正式评分或奖项变化）。普通观点、推荐、促销软文、无新增信息的旧闻复述仍应 exclude。不得把窗口外旧事件伪装成窗口内 breaking news；标题摘要须体现本次新增内容。
official 要求已打开一手来源；multi_source_verified 要求两家独立可靠来源，A级也不豁免时间/来源要求。未确认内容仅进 rumors，tracking=true，标题摘要保留不确定性。中英文新闻标题和archiveTitle须自带明确的游戏、公司或人物主语，离开上方主体栏仍能独立理解。中文直述具体事实，verification 说明证据边界，不用宣传套话。
每个 include 决定必须填写完整 sharedFactFrame，作为两种语言共用的事实边界；subjectTitleKey/platforms 必须与最终 Canonical 决定一致，日期、时刻、数字、人物机构、版本专名只能来自所选证据，不得新增。
中文游戏名依次查 config/title-translations.json、editorialInput.titleHints，仍缺才做 title-only open-web lookup。优先官方简中，其次已查证广泛使用的 common_translation；否则保留原名，titleZhCn=null、titleZhStatus=unavailable。禁止机翻/自造名称。有官方大陆简中渠道的游戏，版本、角色、职业、模式、机制等采用大陆官方术语。所有名称/术语查询仅规范名称，不得增加事件事实、时间、平台、发行信息、来源分类、tracking 或候选。
默认尝试完整 locales.en：在相同 include/sharedFactFrame 内独立写自然英文，优先英文一手证据正式专名；只有中文证据也不得扩充事实。entries 按 include 顺序以 eventKey 对应，upcoming 仅按 upcomingId 对应本次 patch，继承项不重复。headline/summary/verification/timeNote 必须完整英文，无中文 fallback；sourceReport 完整英文或 null，其余显示字段按需提供英文。
如果无法在事实边界内可靠完成完整英文稿，可以省略 locales.en；publisher 标记 unavailable，不能削弱中文 Canonical 来迁就英文。不要填写 factsDigest/canonicalCopyDigest/localeDigest 或猜最终 entryId，均由 trusted publisher 生成绑定。
archiveTitle 对应 period：日报｜、早报｜、晚报｜；英文对应 Daily Brief |、Morning Brief |、Evening Brief |。Daily 窗口为前日10:10 exclusive 至当日10:10 inclusive，plannedAt=当日12:00；10:10—12:00 新事实属于下一期，历史迁移窗口以 packet 为准。
早报 upcomingMode=replace 重建未来15天；晚报 inherit_and_patch。日报必须使用 upcomingMode=inherit_and_patch，不复制 upcomingBaseline.items；不要因为本次 packet 没有新的发售证据而提交空表覆盖历史。trusted publisher 继承 Canonical 基线并剔除当日及15天窗口外项。仅提交新增/变更 upcoming 或有证据支持延期取消的 removeUpcomingIds，必须有 HTTPS 来源。
upcomingBaseline.refreshRange 是 packet-only 的唯一日历例外：每天核验完整 startInclusive—endInclusive，不把旧期次当作已完成核验。打开开发商/发行商公告或 PlayStation/Nintendo/Xbox/Steam 官方页面；新查事实仅用于日历，不得改变新闻 packages/trackingQueue 决定、正文、时间、factStatus、来源分类或 tracking。无可靠来源不填充，不因发现失败删除条目。
upcomingDiscovery 仅是线索。优先 knownTitle、crossSource、inBaseline=false；采用前打开官方详情，核对完整游戏身份、日期、平台、地区和正式版/抢先体验/移植/DLC。日期冲突不可猜选，reviewLinks 是待阅读文章而非游戏项。对 PC/PlayStation/Xbox/Nintendo 分别检查完整15天；coverage 为 failed/empty_or_changed、列表不全或 omittedCandidates>0 时针对补查，并在 sourceReport 记录实际检查和缺口，不得声称全量覆盖。

packages.headline: Action Roguelite Shape of Dreams Launches on XBOX Today With its Biggest Update Yet

sources.label: Xbox Wire
sources.evidenceText:
Hello, Xbox! I am very happy to finally say this: Shape of Dreams is available today on XBOX Series X|S, and it is day one with XBOX Game Pass. It has been one year since we first opened the world of dreams. In that time, more than 1.5 million players have entered it. Today that […]
Action Roguelite Shape of Dreams Launches on XBOX Today With its Biggest Update Yet
Hello, Xbox! I am very happy to finally say this: Shape of Dreams is available today on XBOX Series X|S, and it is day one with XBOX Game Pass.
It has been one year since we first opened the world of dreams. In that time, more than 1.5 million players have entered it. Today that world opens on XBOX -and it does not arrive alone. Our biggest update yet, The Starless Path, launches at the same moment.
Shape of Dreams is a co-op action roguelite. You take on the role of one of nine Travelers, each drawn to the Rapids for a different reason, and descend deep into a dreamscape that reshapes itself every time you enter.
Combat here is fast, stylish hack-and-slash action, and how you fight is completely up to you. Memories are your abilities. Essences modify and combine with them. With over 200 Memories and Essences to draw from, no two runs shape the same way, and there is no single correct build waiting to be solved.
You can play Shape of Dreams alone from beginning to end. But the Rapids change when you bring company – enemies come faster and hit harder, and builds start working together in ways they never could alone. Up to four Travelers can share the same dream in online co-op.
Shape of Dreams launched on Steam in September 2025, and we have kept building on it ever since. XBOX players will benefit from the learnings of our early build -every improvement we have made over the past year is already incorporated into the version you download today.
Shape of Dreams is available with XBOX Game Pass from day one, so members can step into the Rapids right away. A console bonus costume, Crimson Flash Lacerta, is also available to all Xbox players, including Game Pass members, with no purchase required. You can claim it in game.
Each of the nine playable Travelers fights completely differently. To name a few, Lacerta fights with firearms, Shell wields a blade, and Nachia commands summoned companions. Every Traveler has their own weapons and abilities, a unique combat rhythm, and a personal story waiting to be uncovered.

packages.headline: Bloomwalker: Healing a Broken World, One Bloom at a Time

sources.label: Xbox Wire
sources.evidenceText:
Experience a heartfelt adventure in Bloomwalker. Travel with your moving house, cleanse the pollution from the fallen world, and watch life bloom again in Luminoa.
Bloomwalker: Healing a Broken World, One Bloom at a Time
Some worlds ask to be conquered. Bloomwalker asks to be brought back to life.
Luminoa was once a land shared by people and the spirits of nature. But its sanctuaries have been ravaged by pollution, and the guardians who once protected them have succumbed to madness, becoming incarnations of that pollution. Even the little nature spirits known as higgledies are under threat. You arrive as a traveler with a rare purpose: to restore this fading world alongside your moving house.
Your home travels with you. Bloomwalker ‘s moving house is both your base and your companion, carrying you from sanctuary to sanctuary. As your journey takes you deeper into the world, your house grows alongside you, gaining new functionality that helps you cleanse pollution and press on through hardship.
Here’s what makes Bloomwalker feel different: this is a game driven not by the pressure to survive, but by the joy of bringing a world back to life. Instead of destroying what stands in your way, you cleanse it – washing the pollution from the land and its creatures until color, life, and higgledies return. It can be tense in the moment, but it always lands somewhere warm.
Between journeys, there’s a home to build. Your house’s door opens onto a pocket dimension all your own. A place to raise structures, arrange facilities, and decorate to your heart’s content. Crafting here is never something you do alone; the fruits of that shared work become tools for restoring villages, building housing, and creating gifts that bring you closer to your friends.
Bloomwalker is a journey to restore a broken world and, slowly, to restore your own inner peace along the way.

packages.headline: Character Development and Storytelling in Kernel Hearts, Out Now on XBOX

sources.label: Xbox Wire
sources.evidenceText:
How the creators teamed up to bring their vision of a RPG/JRPG and its unique setting.
Character Development and Storytelling in Kernel Hearts, Out Now on XBOX
Kernel Hearts is an action RPG about magical girls fighting angels to save the world, but it’s so much more than a punchy soundbite can explain. The game and its characters are a love letter to two cultures that have shaped the lives of the developers. Japanese culture inspired the art, the story, even the language of the game itself; but the culture of Argentina, the home of Ephemera Games, permeates through everything, down to Fernet drinking yerba mate during one of her idles.
The game itself takes place in a sort of post-apocalyptic Patagonia, painting the story of a world that had collapsed and is now trying to rebuild. It’s a theme that is familiar in many video games, but not necessarily a setting. The Argentine team at Ephemera Games is uniquely poised to tell this familiar story in a new way. And they do this by combining elements of their favorite games into something new entirely. 
Kernel Hearts was born in a game jam in 2020, a rough idea of a world that would eventually become Babel, but the game’s style was developed over years. Akira, the Game Director of Kernel Hearts , says that long action RPGs and JRPGs have always held a special place in his heart; but like many of us, his ability to get absolutely engrossed in those games in the way that we love has changed. Not because of the games themselves, but because the time we have to play as we grow older changes.
The characters also make up a vital part of both the story and the gameplay. In any game with an ensemble cast of characters, it’s important to balance abilities and personalities to make a cohesive group for character interactions in and out of combat. The four girls of the M.A.H.O.U unit do just that, and it’s easy to see even in the trailer.
Akira defined one of the guiding ideas that lead to the design of the four main characters by stating: “A character shouldn’t just have a different weapon. You should be able to watch a few seconds of gameplay and immediately understand something about their personality. Their animations, silhouettes, magic, movement, and even the rhythm of their attacks all have to tell you who that person is.”
That’s how you end up with the differing characters in Kernel Hearts. Fernet fights with swords and spirits which allows her to be the most versatile member of the team. Spika fights up-close with her katana with very clean and disciplined attacks that reflect her disciplined personality. Laika is the most physically impressive of the team, and her massive sword and heavy attacks follow suit. Finally, Dolce fights in a way that you might not expect in a post-apocalyptic setting: incorporating performance and dance into her fighting style, a callback to some of the more familiar magical girls in pop culture.
Assembling your team in the game is just as vital as assembling it in real life. Kernel Hearts is a game that can be completed solo; but the developers made a story about a squad teaming up to take down the insurmountable together, and they think that’s something that’s integral to the experience of the game. It makes sense to play the game in co-op because that’s the nature of the story itself. Just like with the gameplay, though, the developers are aware that trying to get your friends gaming at the same time is a mission all of its own. That’s why Kernel Hearts is a game that can be experienced fully in both single player and multiplayer, though we encourage you to try multiplayer if you can.
So, the team thought: What if we could combine the epic stories we love with the more bite-sized run times of a roguelike? It was this combination of elements that captured our attention at Whitethorn Games: a story-driven game that could be enjoyed in small chunks, incorporating a style of gameplay that we had yet to see in our catalog? We were so on board.

packages.headline: Faraday Blues: Rewrite Your Family’s Fate Across Three Shattered Realities

sources.label: Xbox Wire
sources.evidenceText:
Hi, I’m Zhenghua Yang (Z), Founder of Serenity Forge and Game Director on Faraday Blues. If you just watched the XBOX Tokyo Game Show Broadcast, you saw the world premiere of a game we’ve kept close to our hearts for a long time. Faraday Blues is a surreal sci-fi adventure about a daughter searching for […]
Faraday Blues: Rewrite Your Family’s Fate Across Three Shattered Realities
Hi, I’m Zhenghua Yang (Z), Founder of Serenity Forge and Game Director on Faraday Blues . If you just watched the XBOX Tokyo Game Show Broadcast, you saw the world premiere of a game we’ve kept close to our hearts for a long time.
Faraday Blues is a surreal sci-fi adventure about a daughter searching for parents who don’t know she exists.
The cards in Faraday Blues don’t summon creatures or deal damage. They represent people.
The game is built around a 52-card deck containing characters, memories, items, and subversive pieces of the Faraday family’s history. You place character cards into conversations, locations, and major events, then enter the timeline and experience the consequences of your choices.
Faraday Blues is really three interconnected visual novels, three visual realities, three tragedies, spread across three different eras of the Faraday family. Each reality takes a completely different shape, with its own visual identity, atmosphere, narrative style, and version of the apartment you’re exploring.
Across those stories are 64 endings. Some can be victories, but most aren’t.
This story is intensely personal to me, but it’s not mine alone. I’m creating Faraday Blues alongside co-creator and lead artist Satchely (character artist of Doki Doki Literature Club) and narrative director Kevin Ye. All three of us have brought different pieces of ourselves into the game.
You play as Lina, a mysterious girl who awakens somewhere she doesn’t understand. An old computer introduces her to a strange tabletop filled with playing cards. Two of them bear the faces of her parents. However, they have no idea who she is. Worse yet, their lives are already filled with tragedy.
So Lina does the only thing she can: reset the board and try again.

Final Fantasy VII Revelation hands-on report: Into the Whirlwind Maze where Sephiroth awaits
Final Fantasy VII Revelation , launching April 8, 2027 on PlayStation 5, marks the epic final chapter in the remake trilogy following Final Fantasy VII Remake and Final Fantasy VII Rebirth .
Tough foes like Dragon Riders and Gigas await deep inside the Whirlwind Maze. Sephiroth himself appears toward the end of the demo, leading into a fight against Jenova Death. Debuting in the original Final Fantasy VII, the creature returns here with a sinister redesign featuring an unsettling spiky body.
Midway through the battle, Jenova Death’s tentacles sprout and shield the main body from damage until you destroy each one. As the battle continues the tentacles begin spewing fire like flamethrowers. In our session, combining Synergy Abilities and Limit Breaks finally brings down the colossal Jenova Death.
From the distinct fighting styles of Vincent and Cid to the new FITS System and intense boss encounters, this hands-on session offered a great look at what makes this third entry unique. Finish the adventure when Final Fantasy VII Revelation launches on PS5 April 8, 2027.
At Tokyo Game Show 2026, we had our first chance to play a hands-on demo of the PS5 title, featuring a combat-focused portion of the main story. In this demo, we explored the Whirlwind Maze and got the chance to test out combat with newly added playable characters Vincent and Cid, the new FITS System, and battle against Jenova Deathmourner.

packages.headline: Five Years of Solo Development – Interview with Fountains Creator John Pywell

sources.label: Xbox Wire
sources.evidenceText:
An interview with the creator of Fountains on the event of its XBOX release.
Five Years of Solo Development – Interview with Fountains Creator John Pywell
Fountains is a solo-developed Metroidvania inspired by Dark Souls and Hollow Knight , built over five years by creator John Pywell. With the game now launching on XBOX, we spoke with Pywell about its development, influences, and unexpected international success.
Sam : Could you tell us some of your favourite games? Do you see anything of those games in Fountains ?
John: Well, it might be obvious from the content of Fountains , but Dark Souls 1 is my favourite single-player game of all time. The twisting, interlocking world design of the first game in the series is so mysterious to me. After playing it, I wished there were more games with world designs like that, and unfortunately the sequels are more linear. That’s one of the main reasons I made Fountains . Another favourite game of mine is Satisfactory . If you don’t know of it, it’s a first-person factory-building game. It’s obviously nothing like Fountains , but I love optimizing and solving problems, so I think it appeals to the programmer part of my brain.
Sam : What was your main motivation for making Fountains ? Seeing a video game through to the end is not an easy task.
John: Like I touched on earlier, I love when games are mysterious. When you find a secret in an RPG, it sometimes feels like you’re the first person to ever see that part of the game. My goal in making Fountains was to create a world with a real feeling of mystery. If you play the game, you’ll notice this; there is practically nothing telling you what your goal is or where to go. Your only option is to explore the world and uncover the story for yourself.
John : The mechanisms for exploration are very inspired by the Metroidvania genre. The main idea is that the entire world is technically open to you at all times, but there are certain tools and skills you need to acquire to progress. This creates a satisfying loop where players encounter a barrier, make a mental note of it, and later return with the right skill or item to push forward. It’s about rewarding curiosity and giving players those “aha!” moments as they gradually learn the world’s layout and secrets. The main battle mechanic of hitting enemies to regain your magic resource was shamelessly stolen from Hollow Knight , although I’m not sure who first invented it. Hollow Knight is my favourite game in the Metroidvania genre, so it was also a big inspiration for the exploration-focused gameplay in Fountains .
Sam : Did you feel any restrictions when making the game, or was it a smooth process? Is there something you’d like to explore in the future that you would have liked to explore in Fountains but didn’t get the chance?
Sam : So firstly, tell us a bit about yourself – a brief introduction of anything you’d like to say or not say.
John: I’m John Pywell, a computer science graduate from Canada. Halfway through high school, I took my first computer programming course, and when I realized I was good at it, I never stopped. I work full time in the field, plus a ton of my free time as you can see.
Sam : What was your earliest memory of video games?

packages.headline: Tokyo Game Show 2026: Bill Skarsgård Cast as Lead Role in PHYSINT

sources.label: Xbox Wire
sources.evidenceText:
In partnership with XBOX, KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS announced the casting of the protagonist of the upcoming action-espionage game alongside a new poster.
Tokyo Game Show 2026: Bill Skarsgård Cast as Lead Role in PHYSINT
Just when it appeared that the XBOX Tokyo Game Show 2026 Broadcast had come to a close, legendary game creator Hideo Kojima arrived with one more surprise: fresh updates on OD – KNOCK and PHYSINT , including the news that Swedish actor and producer Bill Skarsgård will portray the lead role in PHYSINT , the upcoming action-espionage game from KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS. 
Kojima-san also shared a new poster for the title featuring a photo he personally shot of Skarsgård alongside Charlee Fraser, offering a fresh glimpse at the talent helping bring this ambitious project to life. 
“I’m delighted to confirm the lead role for PHYSINT will be Bill Skarsgård,” said KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS founder Hideo Kojima in a press release . “We are both long-time fans of each other’s work, and we’ve decided to embark on this new adventure together. The costume fittings, scans, and camera tests we conducted with Bill and Charlee earlier this year gave me tremendous confidence in the direction of the project.”
Most recently, Skarsgård received rave reviews for his performance in Gus Van Sant’s Dead Man’s Wire (2026). He next stars in Peter Bergs’s The Mosquito Bowl and Andrew Niccol’s Lords of War opposite Nicolas Cage. Earlier this year he co-starred in The Death of Robin Hood (Michael Sarnoski, 2026) with Hugh Jackman and Jodie Comer. Skarsgård gained international recognition for his portrayal of the iconic clown Pennywise in It (Andy Muschietti, 2017), a role he reprised in It: Chapter Two (Andy Muschietti, 2019). His film career spans titles such as Nosferatu (Robert Eggers, 2024), Barbarian (Zach Cregger, 2022), The Crow (Rupert Sanders, 2024), Atomic Blonde (David Leitch, 2017), John Wick: Chapter 4 (Chad Stahelski, 2023), The Devil All the Time(Antonio Campos, 2020) and Boy Kills World (Moritz Mohr, 2023). On television, he recently starred in It: Welcome to Derry (2025), the It prequel series for HBO Max, in which he reprised the role of Pennywise and also served as executive producer. His television credits also include Clark (Jonas Åkerlund, 2022), Castle Rock (2018–2019), and Hemlock Grove (2013–2015).
He joins an ensemble cast that includes Fraser, Don Lee, and Minami Hamabe with Kojima-san promising further casting updates in the future.
Last week, XBOX and KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS announced that XBOX will publish PHYSINT , expanding a relationship that already includes OD . The collaboration also extends beyond games, with the companies working together across film and television to bring new stories to broader audiences.

XBOX @ Tokyo Game Show 2026: All the Announcements, Including an Appearance by Hideo Kojima
Tokyo Game Show is a celebration of the creators, developers, and communities shaping the future of gaming . As we celebrate 25 years of XBOX and over 20 years in Japan, Tokyo Game Show is an opportunity to recognize the players, creators, and developers who have helped define gaming culture.
During the XBOX Tokyo Game Show 2026 Broadcast, we offered players a look at what’s coming to XBOX from Activision, Bethesda, KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS, KOEI TECMO, and SEGA. The show featured 17 fresh gameplay reveals, announcements, a surprise release, and a world premiere.
We saw a new campaign trailer for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 , launching October 23, 2026, while Fallout 76 showed an animated trailer for its eerie new update, The Slasher, available now.
Studios throughout Asia and around the globe brought even more surprises. Serenity Forge unveiled a world premiere for Faraday Blues, Netmarble bought brand-new gameplay for Bloomwalker (which is now officially part of the beloved Ni No Kuni universe) , and SEGA revealed Japan as one of the locations coming to Crazy Taxi: World Tour .
We also saw new gameplay for Raji: Kaliyuga , Wo Long 2, Wings of Ember and Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement , a character reveal for Persona 4 Revival , and shared that Shape of Dreams is available to play on XBOX today .
And the broadcast ended with an unforgettable “one more thing” appearance by none other than Hideo Kojima. Check out our full recap below to catch up on everything shown during the broadcast. 
Just when it appeared that the XBOX Tokyo Game Show 2026 Broadcast had come to a close, legendary game creator Hideo Kojima appeared to reveal fresh updates on OD – KNOCK and PHYSINT , including that Swedish actor and producer Bill Skarsgård will portray the lead role in PHYSINT , sharing a new poster for the title featuring Skarsgård and Charlee Fraser. Read the full story here .
